title: Kenyan Dark Molasses Bread
description: A rich and savory bread infused with the deep flavors of Kenyan dark coffee and molasses. Perfect for a hearty breakfast or snack.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine flour, salt, and coffee.
2. Add molasses and water, and mix until a sticky dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise for 1 hour.
6. Punch down the dough and shape into a round loaf.
7. Place the loaf on a baking sheet and bake for 35-40 minutes.
8. Remove from oven and let cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes.
